# Order processing

## Review

Could you add a client named done in the top left, and would you rename done to approval.

Please shift approval in the center. Sprinkle some icons around the edges. Scale the client to small.

Now insert a green service, and would you insert a red customer. Can you organize everything in a column. I need you to paint the customer blue and then okay so insert a triangle right of the blue customer.

Could you link the client to the triangle. Translate every label into French. Please draw a red process labelled warehouse.

Please create a black file named scheduler 200 pixels left of the process. A cloud hovers above the server, suggesting remote storage. Could you insert three queues.

## Back office

I need you to remove every queue. Also, i need you to tidy everything in a grid and okay so duplicate scheduler.

Would you resize the customer to medium. Now make the customer teal. After that, could you connect the customer and the triangle with a pink line. Also, would you draw a pink database.

Could you move the client inside the pink database. Can you drag approval to the left edge.

Can you enlarge the client. Then now on the left side , draw a dotted decision, but now push the dotted decision to the right edge. Would you make the decision tiny.

## Notifications

Change the color of the cloud to red please. Before that, create a dashed cloud named beta on the left side please.

Please change the color of the customer to gray. I want you to remove it.

Could you move the service 5 pixels right of the red cloud. Then i need you to duplicate the decision inside the green service. Lets place a box above the triangle, and lets place a service 80 pixels above the green service from the first section. Also, now connect the service from the third section to approval with a large connector.

Enlarge the triangle please. Give the user a happy face. I want you to shrink the triangle. After that, please make it 60 % smaller and i want you to make it 100 % smaller.

## Data layer

I need you to draw a file. Then i need you to place a diamond on the right side. Never rename the diamond to accounts please.

Connect the diamond to the file. Lets bring the diamond to front. Connect the diamond and the file with an arrow.

Could you draw a black database below the file. Keep a backup of this somewhere safe. I need you to attach the database to the file with a dotted line.

I need you to sketch six teal triangles. The marketing team prefers softer colours. I need you to sketch a tiny hexagon in the lower right.

## Billing

Would you add a gateway called mark at the bottom and would you group these teal triangles into a container called reports_db and then i need you to place a red service left of the hexagon. Lets distribute the teal triangles evenly vertically.

Now arrange everything as a tree. I need you to move the hexagon to the top edge, but i want you to space the triangles 40 px apart and then could you remove the gateway and then okay so never rename the service to beta.

I want you to enlarge the service. After that, can you push the hexagon a third of the way to the top edge, but please shift the hexagon down and then lets join the hexagon to the diamond.

Would you insert two thick captions. Also, can you connect the black database to the file with an arrow. Please draw a task named peter. Also, would you put a purple diamond at the top. I want you to attach the second diamond to the file with a thick line.

Can you slide the file 120 pixels down. Okay so never make it 75 % bigger. After that, please place a customer left of the file.
